title: Held-to-Maturity Accounting: Hidden Losses and Systemic Fragility
abstract: arXiv:2611.26700v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies how accounting-induced opacity affects systemic risk in the banking system. Motivated by the buildup of unrealized losses during recent monetary tightening episodes, we develop a model in which banks hold correlated interest rate sensitive assets and are connected through an endogenous interbank network. We show that Held-To-Maturity (HTM) accounting amplifies systemic risk by delaying loss recognition, allowing losses to accumulate and become synchronized across institutions. When losses are realized under liquidity stress, the interaction of correlated exposures and network linkages generates nonlinear increases in defaults. These findings suggest that accounting regimes are not neutral from a financial stability perspective, as they influence both the buildup and propagation of systemic risk, particularly in environments with common asset exposures and strong interconnectedness.

translated_title: 持有至到期会计：隐性损失与系统性脆弱性
translated_abstract: 本文研究会计制度所引发的不透明性如何影响银行体系的系统性风险。受近期货币紧缩时期未实现损失不断累积现象的启发，我们构建了一个模型，其中银行持有相关的利率敏感型资产，并通过内生形成的银行间网络相互连接。我们证明，持有至到期会计通过延迟损失确认而放大系统性风险，使损失得以累积并在各机构之间趋于同步。当损失在流动性压力下被实际确认时，相关性敞口与网络联系的相互作用会导致违约呈非线性增长。这些发现表明，从金融稳定的角度来看，会计制度并非中性，因为它们同时影响系统性风险的累积与传播，尤其是在存在共同资产敞口和高度互联的环境中。
tldr: 本文构建银行间内生网络模型，揭示持有至到期会计通过延迟损失确认使隐性损失在互联银行间同步累积，并在流动性压力下引发违约的非线性增长，从而显著放大系统性风险。
